filter-column-age-hint: Xiquintlatia amatlapaltin tlen ocalacqueh ipan inin tocatlahtolli ocachi inin quezqui tonaltin achto. Occequih tocatlahtoltin huan amatlapaltin tlen amo momati in incalactonalli noihqui monextiah. Ipatlaliz amatlapalli amo occeppa quipehualtia icahuitl ipan tocatlahtolli.
filter-on-desc: Tiquinchipahua amatlapaltin ipan inin huapalli. Xictoca nican inic ticpatlas tlachipahualiztli.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Xicpehpena amatlapaltin intonal ica @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt o @listEnteredAt. Neixcuitilli: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' o @endAt = none. Xictlali itoca in tlac tlen timochihuilia huan pehua ica @ inepantla comillas.
advanced-filter-description: Hueyi tlachipahualiztli mitzcahuilia xictlahcuilo ce tlahtolli tlen quipia inin tequitiltin: == != <= >= && || ( ) Ce cahcahualli quinxeloa tequitiltin. Huel tiquinchipahuas mochi monemac tlaltin ica intocayo ihuan impatiuh. Machiyotl: Field1 == Value1. Tlanonotzaliztli: Intla tlaltin noso patiuhtin quipiah cahcahualli, xiquintzacuati ica zan ce tlahtolmachiyotl. Machiyotl: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Inic ticpanos zan ce tlanahuatilmachiotl (' \/), huel tictequihuis \. Machiyotl: Field1 == I\'m. Noihqui huel ticnelos miyac tlamantli. Machiyotl: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Mochipa mochi tequitiltin mocaquih itech opochtli hasta yecma. Huel ticpatlas tlatecpanaliztli ica tiquintlalis tlatzacuatin. Machiyotl: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Noihqui huel tictemos tlahtoltlaltin ica regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Monelhuayōtia ihcuac ce tlahcuilōlmachiyōtl mochīhua, ahnozo tocaitl ahnozo tlahtōltēnyōtl mocuepa, īhuān yancuīc tlahtōlli quipiya inin (ahmo motta huēyi ahnozo tepitōn tlahcuilōlli).
imported-member-no-account: Tlacatl calaquic — ayamo onca tlacatequitilamatl namictih
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Xicpepecho ce Kanboard tlaquixtilli JSON: ce tlamantli ica "columns" (noso tequitl ica column_name) ihuan ce "tasks" tlatecpanalli (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tasks mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-deck: Xicpepecho ce NextCloud Deck huapalli JSON (ce huapalli ica "stacks", sesen stack quipia "cards"). Stacks mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan cards mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Xicpepecho ce OpenProject work-packages nechicoliztli JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan work packages mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-issues: Xicpepecho ce __sourceName__ ahcuallotl JSON tlatecpanalli (__endpoint__). Ahcuallotin mocuepah amatlapaltin tlatecpanaltin ipan Open / Closed tocatlahtoltin.
import-board-instruction-asana: Xicpepecho ce Asana tequitl tlaquixtilli JSON ({ "data": [...] } itech Asana tlaquixtilli noso GET /tasks). Tequitl monechicoa ipan secciones (memberships); tequitl tlamic yauh Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Xicpepecho ce ZenKit tocatlahtolli tlaquixtilli JSON ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan items mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Xitlali ce markdown tequitl tlanechicolli (in nescayotl tlen tequitl markdown-kanban iuhqui Obsidian Kanban quitequitiltia): "## Tlanechicolli itoca" tlahtolpani, ihuan "- [ ]"/"- [x]" tlamantli tlatzintlan. Tlahtolpani mocuepa tlanechicolli ihuan tlamantli mocuepa amamachiotl.
import-board-instruction-leo: Xicpepecho in Leo tlatecpanaliztli (.leo tlahcuilolli). In tlamantli tlacpac cateh mocuepah tocatlahtolli, in impilhuan mocuepah amatlapalli, ihuan in tlamantli itlahcuilol mochihua amatlapalli itlahtol. In tlamantli oc achi tlatzintlan cateh mocuepah tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli. In tlamantli machiyotia motlaliah iuhquin ye otlanqueh.
import-board-instruction-opml: Xictlali ce OPML tlanextiliztli, quen quiquixtiah Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq ihuan occequintin. Achtopa tlamantli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin, inpilhuan mocuepah amatlapaltin ica tlahcuilolli quen tlahtolli, ihuan tlamantli tlen oc temo mocuepah tlanextiliztocatlahtoltin. Tlamantli tlamiltin mocalaquiah quen otlan.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Xictlali ce Org mode tlanamactli, quen quitlahcuiloah Emacs, Orgzly noso Beorg. Achtopa tzontecomatl mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan ic ome tzontecomatl mocuepah amatlapaltin. TODO ihuan DONE, achtopayotl, machiotl, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ihuan CLOSED mopiah, ihuan tlamachiotiloni ihuan tzontecomatl tlen oc temo mocuepah tlanextiliztocatlahtoltin.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Xicpepecho ce todo.txt amatlahcuilolli: ce tequitl ipan ce tlaxotlalli, iuhquih quihcuiloa in todo.txt tepoztequitl ihuan occequintin tlen ihuan huel tequitih. Tequitl tlen otlan ("x") yauh "Otlan", +project ihuan @context mocuepah machiyotl, (A) mocuepa machiyotl tlen achto monequi, ihuan due: ihuan t: mocuepah tonalli tlen tlamiz ihuan pehuaz.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Xicpepecho in tlein quiza ipan task export: ce JSON tlahuipantli, nozo ce tequitl ipan cece tlahuipantli. In tequitl tlamitoc yahui ipan Done; project ihuan priority mochihua machiotl, annotations mochihua tlahtolpehualiztin, ihuan depends quimotitia in tequitl tlein quitzacua occe tequitl.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Xictlapo in .boardarchive amatl ihuan xicpepecho in huapalli board.jsonl, ica nozo amo ica in versión itlahuipan. In huapalli itlachiyaliz in tlein quinechicoa mochihua tocatlahtoltin; occe tlamantli tlein huel ticpehpena mochihua machiotl. In tlahcuilolli ihuan in nauhcampa tlein ticmachiotia imaxelol mochihua tlahtolli ihuan tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli; tlahtolpehualiztin mocahuilia. Ixiptlahuan ihuan amatl tlein motlalilia amo calaqui.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Ipan MeisterTask, xictlacui tequiyotl itocayo, xicpehpena Export project ihuan xicquixti CSV, satepan xictlali. Xeloliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica intlahcuilol, tlamiliztonalli, tlanahuatilli ihuan machiotl; tequitl tlamiltin quipiah intlamiliztonal. Ce CSV tlahcuilolli para MeisterTask icalaquiliz no tequiti.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Ipan Obsidian, xictlapo Kanban huapalli itlanamac quen Markdown (noso xictlapo .md tlanamactli ipan ce tlahcuilolpatlaloni), satepan xictlali mochi. Ohtin mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ica inamatlapalhuan itlamiliz, amatlapaltin quipiah inmachiohuan, tonalli, achtopayotl, tlaltin ihuan tlanextiliztocatlahtolli, ihuan Archive mocuepa amatlapaltin ipan pixcalli.
import-board-instruction-linear: Ipan Linear, xiquinquixti tlahtlaniliztli quen CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, noso ce tlachializtli iquixtiliz), satepan xictlali CSV. Nemiliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin, tlanechicolli mocuepah ohtin, ihuan tlahtlaniliztli mocuepah amatlapaltin ica intlanahuatil, machiotl, tonalli, tetahtzin tlahtlaniliztli, achtopayotl, tlatemachiliztli, tequiyotl ihuan cuepaliztli.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Ipan TickTick, xictlapo Settings, Account, Backup & Import ihuan xicchihua ce tlapializtli, satepan xictlali CSV tlanamactli. Sesen TickTick tocatlahtolli mocuepa ohtli ihuan itlaquetzalhuan mocuepah tocatlahtoltin; tequitl quipiah inmachiohuan, tonalli, tlanextiliztocatlahtolli, achtopayotl ihuan tequitontli.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Ipan ClickUp, xiquinquixti tequitl quen CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, noso ce List noso Table tlachializtli iquixtiliz ica nochtin tlaquetzalli), satepan xictlali CSV. Nemiliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin, ClickUp tocatlahtoltin mocuepah ohtin, ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin ica intequitonhuan, tlanahuatiltin, machiotl, tonalli, achtopayotl ihuan cahuitl.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Ipan Nullboard, xictlapo huapalli, xicpehpena Export this board... ipan tlaahxitiliztli, xictlapo .nbx tlanamactli ipan ce tlahcuilolpatlaloni ihuan xictlali tlen quipia. Tocatlahtoltin mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tlahcuilolli mocuepah amatlapaltin: ce tlahcuilolli iachtopa tlahcuilolpan yez amatlapalli itocayo ihuan occe yez itlahtol. Ce tlahcuilolli raw quiselia machiotl raw. Ce tlanamactli ica miec huapaltin quicalaquia iachtopa huapal.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Ipan Kanri, xictlapo Import & Export ihuan xicpehpena Export individual board (noso Export all data), satepan xictlali .json tlanamactli. Tlaquetzalli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan amatlapaltin mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica intlahtol, tlamiliztonalli, machiotl ihuan tlapalli; ce amatlapalli itequiuh mocuepa tlanextiliztocatlahtolli. Ipan ce nochi tlapializtli iquixtiliz mocalaquia achtopa huapalli.
import-board-instruction-planka: Xicmachiyotlali in ichan mo Planka (quemeh https://planka.example.com), mo tequitini itoca ihuan mo ichtaca tlahtolli ipan Planka, zatepan xicpachoa «Xicnextili tlen huelitiz calaquiz». Zan ic motequitiltia ic mocui in amatl ihuan amo mopixtoc. Xicpehpena ce amatl ihuan xicpachoa «Xiccui»: WeKan quipoa ipan in API ica Planka ica itocatlahtolhuan, iamatlapalhuan, itlanextiliz, itonal tlamiliz, imachiohuan, itlacamehuan, itequitocatlahtolhuan ihuan itlahtolhuan, zatepan xicchihua in calaquiliztli quemeh mochipa. In amatlapalli ipan pixcalli ica Planka calaquih quemeh opixqui; in tlen tzonilpitoc ihuan in amatlapalli ipan tlazolcomitl amo calaquih.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Ipan Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), xicalaqui, xictlacaquiti in tlahuelitiliztli Tasks.Read ihuan xiccopina in token ipan Access token. Xicpilo nican ihuan xicpachoa «Xicnextili tlen huelitiz calaquiz»; in token zan ic inin tlacuiliztli motequitiltia ihuan amo mopixtoc. Xicpehpena mochi tocatlahtolli nozo ce ihuan xicpachoa «Xiccui». Cecen tocatlahtolli To Do mochihua tocatlahtolli ihuan cecen tequitl ce amatlapalli, ica itlahcuilolhuan, itonal tlamiliz ihuan peuhyan, ipasohuan quemeh tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli, itlamantihuan quemeh machiotl, huei tlamachiliztli ihuan quenin icaca quemeh machiotl; in tequitl tlen otlan mopixtoc. In tlaelnamiquiliztli ihuan tlacuepaliztli amo calaquih.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Ipan KanbanFlow, xictlapo in menu ica amatl, xicpehpena Settings → API & Webhooks ihuan xiccopina in API token ica amatl. Xicpilo in token nican, xicpachoa «Xicnextili tlen huelitiz calaquiz», xicpehpena in amatl ihuan xicpachoa «Xiccui»; in token zan ic on tlacuiliztli motequitiltia ihuan amo mopixtoc. In tlaquetzalli mochihuah tocatlahtolli ihuan in ohtli mocahuah ohtli; in tequitl quipiah itlanextiliz, itlapal, imachiohuan, itonal tlamiliz, itequipilhuan quemeh tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli, in cahuitl tlen motequitilti, in tlapohualli, in tlacameh ihuan in tlahtolli.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Xicmachiyotlali in ID ica mo Basecamp (in tlapohualli zatepan basecamp.com/ ipan ichan) ihuan ce token ic calaquiz (ica ce app OAuth 2 tlen omotlalih ipan launchpad.37signals.com, nozo tlen ye quipia ce tlanahuatilli), xicpachoa «Xicnextili tlen huelitiz calaquiz», xicpehpena ce tlachihualli ihuan xicpachoa «Xiccui». In token zan ic on tlacuiliztli motequitiltia ihuan amo mopixtoc. Cecen amatlapalli tlapepechtli mochihua ohtli ica itlaquetzalhuan quemeh tocatlahtolli, ihuan in tocatlahtolli tlen monequi mochihuaz mochihuah ohtli «To-dos»; in amatlapalli quipiah itlahcuilol, itonalhuan, tlacameh ihuan tlahtolli, in ipasohuan ce amatlapalli mochihuah tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli, ihuan tlen otlan mopixtoc.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Xiccui ce token ic calaquiz ipan OAuth 2.0 Playground: tlatzintlan Tasks API v1 xicpehpena tasks.readonly, xicpachoa Authorize APIs, zatepan Exchange authorization code for tokens, ihuan xiccopina in token. Xicpilo nican ihuan xicpachoa «Xicnextili tlen huelitiz calaquiz», xicpehpena mochi tequitocatlahtolli nozo ce, zatepan «Xiccui». In token zan ic inin tlacuiliztli motequitiltia ihuan amo mopixtoc. In tequitocatlahtolli mochihuah tocatlahtolli ihuan in tequitl mochihuah amatlapalli, ica itlahcuilolhuan, itlazalolhuan ihuan itonal tlamiliz; in tequipilli mochihuah tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli ihuan in tequitl tlen otlan calaquih quemeh opixqui.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: In API ica Google Keep zan ic Google Workspace. Xiccui ce token OAuth 2.0 ica https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (ipan OAuth 2.0 Playground intla mo tlayacanqui Workspace quicahua, nozo ica ce tequipanoliztli ID ica nochi domain), xicpilo, xicpachoa «Xicnextili tlen huelitiz calaquiz» zatepan «Xiccui». In token zan ic inin tlacuiliztli motequitiltia ihuan amo mopixtoc. In tlahcuilolli mochihuah amatlapalli ipan tocatlahtolli «Notes», ihuan in tlahcuilolli ica tlaixnamiquiliztli mochihuah amatlapalli ipan tocatlahtolli «Lists» ica itlamanhuan quemeh tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli. In tlahcuilolli ipan tlazolcomitl, in tlen tzonilpitoc ihuan in tlamamaliztli amo calaquih.
api-import-desc: Xiccui ipan in tequipanoliztli ica mo ID. Tlen nican ticmachiyotlalia zan ic inin tlacuiliztli motequitiltia ihuan amo mopixtoc.
api-import-fetched: Omocuic. Xiquitta in tlacameh tlatzintlan ihuan xiccalaqui.
api-import-nothing: Amo onca tlen calaquiz ica inin cuenta.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Ipan Pivotal Tracker, xictlapo tequiyotl iMORE tlaxeloliz ihuan xicpehpena Export CSV (noso xiquinpehpena tlaquetzaliztli ihuan xicpehpena Bulk Actions, CSV), satepan xictlali CSV. Sesen tlaquetzaliztli inemiliz mocuepa tocatlahtolli ihuan tlaquetzaliztli mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica innemiliz ihuan machiotl, tecuhtin, tetlahtlaniani, tonalli, tlahtolpehualiztli, tequitl ihuan tlatzacuiliztli; Estimate mocuepa Story points ihuan cuepaliztli mocuepah sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Ipan Tasks.org, xictlapo Settings, Backups ihuan xicpehpena Export tasks, satepan xictlali tlen quipia inon .json tlanamactli. Tocatlahtoltin mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica intlahcuilol, machiotl, tonalli, tlahtolpehualiztli ihuan tequitontli; tequitl tlamiltin quipiah intlamiliztonal, ihuan achtopayotl mocuepa monemac tlalli.
import-board-instruction-monday: Ipan monday.com, xictlapo huapalli itlaahxitiliz, xicpehpena More actions ihuan Export board to Excel (ica yancuiliztli ihuan tlamantontli intla ticnequi), satepan xicpehpena inon .xlsx tlanamactli. Status tlaquetzalli mocuepa tocatlahtoltin ihuan nechicoliztli mocuepah ohtin; tlacah, tonalli, tonalcuepohualli ihuan machiotl quipiah inyeyan, occequintin tlaquetzalli mocuepah monemac tlaltin ihuan yancuiliztli mocuepah tlahtolpehualiztli.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Ipan Super Productivity, xictlapo Settings, satepan Sync & Backup, xicpehpena Export Data ihuan xictlali tlen quipia sp-backup .json tlanamactli. Sesen tequiyotl mocuepa ohtli ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin ipan To Do, In Progress, Backlog noso Done, ica intlahcuilol, machiotl, tlamiliztonalli, cahuitl tlen opanoc ihuan tequitontli; tequitl ipan pixcalli mocuepah amatlapaltin ipan pixcalli.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Ipan Taiga, xictlapo Admin > Project > Export ihuan xictemohui tequiyotl itlapializ (achtopa xictlapo ce .json.gz tlanamactli), satepan xictlali iJSON. User story nemiliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin, user stories mocuepah amatlapaltin ica intequiuh quen tequitontli, epics ihuan tlahtlaniliztli quipiah inohhuan, ihuan sprints, machiotl, tlahtolpehualiztli ihuan monemac tlamantli no huallauh. Tlanamictilli amo mocalaquiah.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Ipan Vikunja, xictlapo Settings, xicpehpena Data Export ihuan xictemohui .zip tlanamactli tlen mitztitlania, satepan xicpehpena inon tlanamactli, noso xictlali data.json tlen quipia. Kanban caxitl mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica inmachiohuan, tlanahuatiltin, tonalli, tlahtolli, tequitl itocatlahtol quen tlanextiliztocatlahtoltin ihuan tlahtolpehualiztli; achtopayotl, quezqui ipan ciento otlan ihuan otlan mocuepah monemac tlaltin. Tlanamictilli amo mocalaquiah.
import-board-instruction-quire: Ipan Quire, xictlapo tequiyotl itlaahxitiliz ihuan xicpehpena Export CSV, satepan xictlali CSV. Nemiliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica intequitonhuan quen amatlapalpipiltin, tlanahuatiltin, machiotl, pehualiztonalli, tlamiliztonalli ihuan tlantzontonalli, tlahtolli ihuan achtopayotl quen monemac tlalli. Tlahtolpehualiztli ihuan tlanamictilli amo cateh ipan Quire iCSV.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Ipan Wrike, xicquixti ce tequiyotl noso amatlatlatiloni ipan Excel, noso xictemiti Wrike iExcel icalaquiliz neixcuitilli, satepan xicpehpena inon .xlsx tlanamactli. Amatlatlatiloni ihuan tequiyotl tlahcuilolpan mocuepah ohtin, Status mocuepa tocatlahtoltin ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica inKey, tetahtzin tequitl, tlanahuatiltin, pehualiztonalli ihuan tlantzontonalli, netechpanoliztli ihuan tlahtolli; Priority, Duration ihuan occequintin tlaquetzalli mocuepah monemac tlaltin.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Ipan Teamwork.com, xictemiti Excel tequitl icalaquiliz neixcuitilli (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ihuan xicpiya quen .xlsx, satepan xicpehpena inon tlanamactli. Tequitl itocatlahtol mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin; ce tequitl tlen pehua ica -, # noso > mocuepa itequiton tequitl tlen icpac ca (--, ## noso >> ce tlamantli oc temo). Tlanahuatiltin, tonalli ihuan machiotl quipiah inyeyan; Priority, Estimated time ihuan Complete mocuepah monemac tlaltin.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Ipan Businessmap (achtopa Kanbanize), xictlapo Advanced Search, xicpehpena Configure results ic tiquinpehpenaz tlaquetzalli, xictemohui Excel tlanamactli, satepan xicpehpena inon .xlsx tlanamactli. Tlaquetzalli mopohuah ica intocayo ipan inglés (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): intla motequiuh quitequihuia occe tlahtolli, achtopa xicpatla tzontecomatl tlahcuilolpan ipan inglés. Column mocuepa tocatlahtoltin ihuan Lane ohtin; tecuhtin, machiotl, tlapalli, tonalli, tlahtolpehualiztli ihuan tetahtzin ilpiliztli quipiah inyeyan, ihuan Priority, Size, Type ihuan occequintin tlaquetzalli mocuepah monemac tlaltin.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Ipan Redmine, xictlapo tequiyotl iIssues, xicpehpena Also available in: CSV itzintlan tocatlahtolli, xiquinpehpena tlaquetzalli (All columns, ica Description) ihuan xicquixti, satepan xictlali CSV. Redmine quintocayotia tlaquetzalli ipan motlahtol, ic xictlali motlahtol ipan inglés ipan My account achtopa ticquixtiz. Sesen nemiliztli mocuepa tocatlahtolli ihuan tlahtlaniliztli mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica tracker quen machiotl, tlanahuatilli, tlachiuhqui, tonalli, tetahtzin tequitl ihuan tlahtlaniliztli tlen monetechpanoah; achtopayotl, tlamantli, tlaneltoquilli tlapatlaliztli, cahuitl tlatemachilli, % Done ihuan monemac tlaltin mocuepah monemac tlaltin.
import-board-instruction-notion: Ipan Notion, xictlapo tlapializtli quen ce nochi amatl, xicpehpena ••• ihuan Export, xicpehpena Markdown & CSV, ihuan xicpehpena .zip tlanamactli tlen motemohuia, noso ce tlapializtli CSV tlen itech quiza, noso xictlali inon CSV. Ce tlaquetzalli itocayo Status mocuepa tocatlahtoltin (intla amo onca, iachtopa tlaquetzalli tlen monextia quen tlapehpenaliztli, ihuan icalaquiliz tlanonotzaliztli quihtoa catlehhuatl); tlahcuilolpan mocuepah amatlapaltin ica intocayo, machiotl, tlacah quen tlacah ipan amatlapalli, tonalli, ihuan amatl itlahcuilol quen tlahtolli; occequintin tlaquetzalli mocuepah monemac tlaltin. Netechpanoliztli, tlachialoni ihuan tlanamictilli amo mocalaquiah.

Nemiliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin, tequiyotl mocuepah ohtin, ihuan tlahtlaniliztli mocuepah amatlapaltin ica inmachiyo, tetahtzin, tlanahuatiltin, machiotl, tonalli, ilpiliztli ihuan tlahtolpehualiztli; achtopayotl, tlatemachiliztli, cuepaliztli ihuan module mocuepah monemac tlaltin. globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - amatlapaltin tlachihualtin ipan *<n>* tonaltin noso achi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - amatlapaltin patlaltin ipan *<n>* tonaltin noso achi

globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - campa *<field>* cah ce itech `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` noso `__predicate_member__`. globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - campa *<sort-name>* cah ce itech `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` noso `__predicate_modified__`. Inic tictecpanas temoc, xiclalili `-` iixpan tlatecpanaliztocayotl.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - campa *<n>* cah ce positivo tlapoualli tlen quimati amatlapaltin tlapoualli tlanextililo ipan sesen amatl.

globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Tequitiltin iyoca monepanoah ica *AND*. Zan amatlapaltin namictih ica mochi iyoca tlamantli mocuepah. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` quincuepa zan amatlapaltin ipan tocatlahtolli *Available* ica machiotl *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Tonaltin huel motlaliah quemeh positivo noso negativo tlapoualli, noso ica `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` noso `__predicate_year__` para axcan cahuitl.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Tlahtol temoliztin amo quixeloah hueyi ihuan tzinco tlahtolli.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Ica tlachihualmachiyotl, amatlapaltin pixcalco amo motemoah.

cards-loading-lazy-note: Yolihui amatlapalli calaquiliztli ca tlayeyecolli: amatlapalli tlapohualtin ihuan WIP itlamil cuali, yece Calendar/Table/Gantt nezquiliztin ihuan miyac-pehpenaliztli quinextiah zan amatlapaltin ye ocalaquihqueh. Occepa xiquintlapo huapaltin ihcuac ticpatlaz inin.

Tlapatlaliztli nican motlachiliah quen netehuiliztli. Ihuitzyan itlapohual tlen amo oncateh amo motlachiliah; ce null nezqui quichipahua tlapoualli tlanamictilli.

email-recovery-description: Ce tlahcuilolpantli ipampa ceceyaca tlaseliani. Xictemo ica tequitiliani i-ID. Amo monextia tlahcuilolli itech onca tlamantli niyon tlaseliani itlahcuilol tlanextiloyan. Quetzaliztli quipiya tlahcuilolli tlen axcan onca ihuan tlen zatepan yez; oc ceppa pehualiztli quiyehyecoa axcan quititlaniz tlahcuilolli tlen quichia. Pololiztli quipoloa tlahcuilolli tlen omotlali ipan tocatlahtolli achto noso ipan tlahtlaniliztli icahuitl. Intla titlaniliztli ye mochihua, xicyehyeco oc ceppa achitzin zatepan. Tlahcuilolli tlen ye motitlania amo huel mocuepa, ihuan intla amo machi intla oahcic, huel oc ceppa motitlaniz. Tlahcuilolli tlen nochipa amo huel motitlania ihuan tlen oahcic tlayehyecoliztli itlamiyan oc mopiya inic motlachiliz. Oc ceppa titlaniliztli pehua yancuic tlayehyecoliztli ihuan quipiya quetzaliztli tlen ye onca.

Tlapatlaliztli nican motlachiliah quen netehuiliztli; ihuitzyan itlapohual tlen amo oncateh amo motlachiliah ihuan ce null nezqui quichipahua tlapoualli.

Ce tlanemililiztli tlapatlaliztli nican mocahua hasta ihuitzyan quipatla inon tlahtlaniliztli itlanemililiz, ihuan ce achtopa namictiliztli amo quemman quiquixtia tlanemililiztli.

Ihcuac ce mochiya, inon tocatlahtolli amo huel monamictia. Xictlaxa ic tocatlahtolli occepa huel monamictiz: tlapatlaliztli tlen ye omochiuh mocahuah, tlapatlaliztli tlapixtli tlen mocahuah amo quemman motlahcuilozqueh, ihuan occe namictiliztli occepa quinamiqui tocatlahtolli ica ihuitzyan.

vcs-no-milestones: Ahmo oc onca tlanextilli. Machiotl ica tlamiliztonalli ce tlanextilli.
vcs-no-list: Ini amatlapalli ahmo quipia tlapohualli noso ohtli inic tlaohuiliztli.
card-qr-code-desc: Xictlachiyalti inic xictlapo ini amatlahcuilolli ipan tepozteixmatiliztli noso tablet.
card-qr-code-too-long: In ilpiliztli ini amatlahcuilolli huel huehueyac inic QR tlahcuilolli.
vcs-no-wiki: Ayamo onca wiki. In GitHub necentlaliliztli calaquiliztli quihualhuica nican iwiki ce tlatiliztli.
github-org-import-desc: Nochi tlatiliztli ce necentlaliliztli noso ce tlatequipanohuani mochihua ihuapal, motlapoa ipan Huapalli itlachializ / Tlapatlaliztli tlachiyaliztli: itlaohuiliztin ica intlahtol, inmachiouh ihuan inamauh, itlanextiliztin, iGitHub Actions tequiohtli quemeh Nahuatiltin, ihuan iwiki.
github-org-import-token-hint: Monequi ic ichtacatlatiliztin ihuan ce hueyi API tlantli. Zan mochihua ihcuac tlacalaquilo ihuan aic mopixtoc.
github-org-import-issues: Tlaohuiliztin, ica tlahtolli, machiotl ihuan amatl
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Xicihcuilo itocayo ce necentlaliliztli noso tlatequipanohuani, noso ichan GitHub.
optional-apis-desc: REST API quemeh in API ipan occequintin tlatepotztocaliztli, inic in intequitlalihuan ihuan inscript huelitih quitequipanozqueh inin WeKan quemeh intlatzintlan: tlen quipixqueh mopixtiuh ipan WeKan, ipan WeKan huapaltin. Cecentetl moxoxolotoc ixquichca nican motlamachiyotia. Ayac quipia ixquich itlahuelitiliz: ce tlacuiliani calaqui ica ce WeKan API token ihuan huel quitta ihuan quipatla zan tlen inon tlacatl huel quitta ihuan quipatla ipan WeKan. Mochintin quinequih ma motlatlati in WeKan REST API (WITH_API=true). In calyetlaliztli itzintlan cecentetl yehhuatl tlen quitequipanoa ce tlacuiliani quemeh iservidor.
optional-api-trello-desc: Tequitlaliltin ihuan script tlen omotlahcuiloh ipampa Trello REST API (quemeh Trellinator) tequitih ica WeKan: huapaltin, tocatlahtoltin, amatlapaltin, machiotl, tlacameh, tlahtolpehualiztin ihuan tlanextiliztocatlahtolli. In Trello token ce WeKan API token. Ic moxoxolhuia ce amatlapalli, mopixcaltia ipan WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: In tlacuilanimeh ipan Jira REST API v2 tequitih ica WeKan: ce tequitl ce huapalli (itlatlapolhuaz in huapalli itlatlapolhuaz), ce tlaohuiliztli ce amatlapalli (DEV-7), ce quenin ca ce tocatlahtolli, ihuan ce panoliztli quiyolinia in amatlapalli. In tlatemoliztli quiseliya JQL tlen amo ohui: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text ihuan ORDER BY. Xicalaqui ica ce WeKan API token quemeh motlahtolichtacayo. Ic moxoxolhuia ce tlaohuiliztli, mopixcaltia.
optional-api-github-desc: In tlacuilanimeh ipan GitHub REST API ipampa tlaohuiliztin tequitih ica WeKan: ce tlapialoyan ce huapalli, ce tlaohuiliztli ce amatlapalli, ica machiotl, tlanextiltin (machiotl ica ce tlamiliztonalli), tlahtolpehualiztin, ihuan tlapouhqui noso tzactli quemeh ipan Tlapatlaliztli tlachiyaliztli. In token ce WeKan API token.
optional-api-gitea-desc: In tlacuilanimeh ipan Gitea ihuan Forgejo REST API ipampa tlaohuiliztin tequitih ica WeKan, zan quemeh in API tlen monamiqui ica GitHub: ce tlapialoyan ce huapalli ihuan ce tlaohuiliztli ce amatlapalli. In token ce WeKan API token.
bots-none: Ayamo onca tepoztlacameh. Ce tepoztlacatl ce tlatequipanoani ipan moservidor - ce AI tlatequipanoani, ce CI tequitl, ce script - in tlein inin huapalli quimaca amatlapalli.
bot-not-found: Inon tepoztlacatl ahmo onca ipan inin huapalli.
bot-option-not-found: Inon tlanancuililiztli ahmo yehuatl tlein oquimacac in tepoztlacatl.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Webhooks tlen quisah amo huelih ahciz tlacanechicolli ipan inechicol WeKan, inic ayac huelitiz quitlachieltiz ce huapalli iwebhook ic ce tlatequipanolli tlen calitic. Xicmicuilo nican in hosts ipan inon nechicolli tlen webhooks huelih ahcih - ce Node-RED, ce tlahtolcalli servidor - ce ipan cecen tlahcuilolli, quemeh tocaitl noso tlacanechicolli, ica ce puerto inic zan inon puerto mochihuaz. Iztac: ayac. Zan tepachoanimeh in tlacatl huelih quipatlah inin amatl.
account-webhook-desc: Ce chantli in WeKan quinahuatia ihcuac aca calaqui nozo mochihua yancuic cuentah. Ahtle mihualia hasta quemman momachiyotia ce tlamantli in tlatzintlan. Quihuica in tlamantli, in tocayotl ihuan in cahuitl; xicmachiyoti occequi zan intla quinequi in aquin quiceliz.
account-webhook-field-ip: IP chantli campa huala in calaquiliztli
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: ¿Xicpolo mochi tlanonotzaliztli tlen quichiya ipan tequitl achi huehueh ica quezqui tonalli?
vcs-synced-from: Omonepano ihuan %s: oncan xictlapo ihuan xictzacua.
vcs-synced-issue: Inin tlaohuiliztli omonepano: xictlapo ihuan xictzacua ipan itlatemoliz.
sync-issue-details: Tlahtolpehualiztin, machiotl, quenin ca ihuan amatl
sync-write-back: Xicmuchihuili tlapatlaliztli in GitLab: tzontecomatl, tlahtolli, tlahtolpehualiztin, tlatzacualiztli ihuan occeppa tlatlapoliztli
sync-write-back-error: Ahmo huelitic in icuiloliztli in GitLab
email-bounces-description: Tlen quichihua WeKan ica tlahcuilolli tlen mocuepa: cantlacatl ahcualli tlahcuilolli, tlahcuilolcaxitl temitica, tenanquiliztli ahmo nican, tlatelchihualiztli ica spam. Cecentlamantli quipia itequiuh, mochihua ihcuac mocuep inon quezquipa.
email-bounces-enabled: Xicpachoa tlahcuilolli tlen mocuepa ipan WeKan
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Ahmo occepa xictitlani tlahcuilolli inin cantlacatl
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Inin cantlacatl ahmo onca: tlahcuilolahcuiliztli, cuentatl polihqui, tlalli ahmo ixmatic.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Axcan ahmo oacic: tlahcuilolcaxitl temitica, tlatequipanoani cenca tequipanoa. Zan miyac ce ica ce quitoznequi itlah.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Tenanquiliztli ahmo nican, cehuiliztli noso tlamachiyotl. Tlahcuilolli oacic.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Aquin quiceliz oquimachiyoti tlahcuilolli quen spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: Ipan Amazon SES, xictitlani tlanonotzaliztli Bounce ihuan Complaint, ihuan ce tlanahuatilli ic celiliztli inic cantlacatl canin WeKan titlani, ce tlamantli SNS, ihuan xicmachiyoti inin cantlacatl ipan ica HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: ARN in SNS tlamantli tlen moceliz, ce ipan cecen tlatlalilli
email-bounces-stopped-only: Zan cantlacatl canin WeKan ahmo occepa titlani tlahcuilolli
email-bounces-clear-hint: Xiquilcahua inin cantlacatl imocuepaliz ihuan occepa xictitlani tlahcuilolli
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Inon ahmo ARN in SNS tlamantli.
email-bounces-providers-description: Intla WeKan tlatitlani ica centetl inin tequitl, xicpehualti, xicmaca tequitl inin cantlacatl webhook ic tlahcuilolli tlen mocuepa ihuan tlatelchihualiztli ica spam, ihuan nican xictlali tlatlapoloni ica quimachiyotia, noso ichtaca tlahtolli tlen otictlali ipan cantlacatl quen https://user:password@… noso ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Tequitl tlen pehualtilo quinequi itlatlapoloni machiyotl noso ichtaca tlahtolli.
activity-pub-enabled: Tepan huapaltin quitemachiltiah intlatequipanol amatlapalli ipan fediverso (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Achtopa tzauctoc. Ihcuac motlapoa, cecen tepan huapalli huelitiz motoquiliz ipan Mastodon ihuan occequintin fediverso tlatequipanohuaz-calli quemeh @board-<id> ipan inin WeKan ichan-tlahcuilol, ihuan yancuic amatlapalli tlatequipanoliztli ahci intech in quitoquilia. Zan mopohua: atle tlen quititlani ce fediverso tlatequipanohuaz-calli quipatla ce huapalli, ihuan ichtacayo huapaltin aic momachiltiah.
caldav-sync-desc: Xictlali in itlamiliztonal in amatlapalli ipan inin huapalli ipan ce tonalamatl - Nextcloud Calendar nozo zazo tlein CalDAV tonalamatl. Ce tlamiliztonalli tlen moolinia ipan tonalamatl mocuepa ipan amatlapalli. Xictequiuhti ce ichtaca tlahtolli ic tlatequipanoltilli, amo moichtaca tlahtol.
caldav-invalid-url: In tonalamatl ichan-tlahcuilol monequi ma yez ce http:// nozo https:// ichan-tlahcuilol, amo ica itoca tlatequitiltiani nozo ichtaca tlahtolli itech.
caldav-not-linked: Achtopa xicpiya ce tonalamatl ichan-tlahcuilol ihuan xictlapo nenepanoliztli.
webdav-storage-description: Xicpiya tlanamictilli ipan ce amachiquihuitl ipan ce WebDAV tlatequipanohuaz-calli - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud nozo occe. Xictequiuhti ce ichtaca tlahtolli ic tlatequipanoltilli tlen mochiuh ic WeKan. Nican huelitiz motequiuhtiz ce tlatequipanohuaz-calli ipan WeKan iyoca tlahtlapitzalli, ipampa zan ce tepachoani quitlalia inin ichan-tlahcuilol.
sqrl-desc: Ahmo motlaliani achtopa. In ihcuac motlaliani, in calaquiliztli amatl quitemaca SQRL, auh in tlacameh achtopa quicaquitiah inSQRL ixiptlayo itech Tlacatl tlaahxitiliztli. SQRL quinequi ma WeKan cah ipan ce https:// tlaixquetzalli.
sqrl-scan: Xiquixcopina in tlahtolmachiyotl ica motepoztlachihual SQRL, noso xictlapo moSQRL tepoztlatequipanoh ipan inin tepoztli.
sqrl-expired: Inin SQRL machiyotl ye opoliuh icauhca. Xipehua occeppa.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL quinequi ma WeKan cah ipan ce https:// tlaixquetzalli.
sqrl-description: Xicalaqui ica moSQRL ixiptlayo ipan ichtaca tlahtolli. Xicaquiti nican cecpa ica moSQRL tepoztlatequipanoh; huel ticquixtiz nican quemmanian.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: In calaquiliztli ica SQRL omotzacuh inic inin cuenta ica moSQRL tepoztlatequipanoh. Xictlapo occeppa ompa ica motemaquixtiliz machiyotl.
sqrl-only-on: MoSQRL tepoztlatequipanoh oquitzacuh inin cuenta zan ica SQRL: occequintin calaquiliztli ohtli moilcahuah.
sqrl-hardlock-on: MoSQRL tepoztlatequipanoh cenca oquitzacuh inin cuenta: ichtaca tlahtolli yancuiliztli ihuan tlahcuilolli patlaliztli moilcahuah.
sqrl-only: Inin cuenta calaqui zan ica SQRL.
sqrl-hardlock: Inin cuenta motzacuh ica SQRL: ahmo huel occeppa mocui nozo mopatla ica occe ohtli.
windows-sso-failed: Ahmo ohuel calac ica Windows. Achtopa amo tlen moamatlacuiloltzin Windows nican quicahua.
